lines.en: label kirindorm10:
I knock on Kirin’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Kirin 的门，等她来应门。

lines.en: It’s a little strange being able to do that after getting so used to just calling her every time I want to see her.
lines.zh: 在习惯了每次想见她就打个电话之后，能这样敲门感觉有点奇怪。

lines.en: But the fact that she’s here now makes my life exponentially easier since this is already my second house.
lines.zh: 但她现在住在这儿，让我的生活轻松了不知多少倍，因为这已经算是我的第二套房了。

lines.en: Kirin and I are basically roommates now.
lines.zh: 我和 Kirin 现在基本上算是室友了。

lines.en: Come to think of it, who {i}is{/i} her roommate?
lines.zh: 话说回来，她的室友{i}是谁{/i}来着？

lines.en: It has to be Noriko, right?
lines.zh: 应该是 Noriko 吧？

lines.en: Either that or she’s just living by herself in here- which would be extremely depressing.
lines.zh: 要么就是她自己一个人住在这儿——那可就太惨了。

lines.en: But I guess if anyone was going to live alone out of the class it would be Kirin.
lines.zh: 不过我想，全班要是有人会一个人住，那大概就是 Kirin。

lines.en: Or Yumi.
lines.zh: 或者 Yumi。

lines.en: Or Maya.
lines.zh: 或者 Maya。

lines.en: Actually, I have a lot of independently “functioning” girls in my class, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: 其实仔细想想，我班上能“独立运转”的女孩还挺多的。

lines.en: : Oh! Noriko, I think this is it. Could we be receiving our first ever visit from Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦！Noriko，我想就是他了。我们这是迎来了有史以来第一次老师来访吗？

lines.en: : The first of many, dear Kirin.
lines.zh: : 许多次里的第一次，亲爱的 Kirin。

lines.en: : Have you prepared the handcuffs?
lines.zh: : 手铐准备好了吗？

lines.en: : I don’t believe handcuffs will be necessary. He seems like the type to willingly tie himself to the bed if it means getting to “hang out” with us.
lines.zh: : 我觉得手铐应该没必要。他看起来像是那种只要能跟我们“一起玩”，就心甘情愿把自己绑在床上的人。

lines.en: : Stop accurately characterizing me from behind the door and let me in.
lines.zh: : 别隔着门这么准确地刻画我了，让我进去。

lines.en: : It’s open! Just walk in if you’re so impatient.
lines.zh: : 门开着！你这么没耐心就自己走进来呗。

lines.en: scene black
I turn the handle and, lo and behold, the door {i}was{/i} open after all.
lines.zh: 我转动门把手，你猜怎么着，门居然真的{i}是{/i}开着的。

lines.en: I don’t know why I ever expect any less at this point.
lines.zh: 我都不知道自己到这一步还在期待什么别的。

lines.en: And if this particular door isn’t locked now, I can’t imagine it ever will be in the future either. So that's cool, I guess.
lines.zh: 而且如果这扇门现在都不锁，我也想象不出它以后会锁上。所以，挺好的吧，我猜。

lines.en: Also, am I wrong for thinking that Dorm 10 seems like it could be a little more...intense than most of the others if these girls’ personalities mesh as well as I expect them to?
lines.zh: 还有，如果这些女孩的性格真的像我预想的那样合得来，那我觉得 Dorm 10 大概会比其他宿舍更……刺激一点，是我多想了吗？

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm1
: Welcome to our humble abode. May I take your coat?
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到我们寒舍。要我帮你拿外套吗？

lines.en: : May I take your pants?
lines.zh: : 要我帮你脱裤子吗？

lines.en: : I'm already being stripped on my first trip here?
lines.zh: : 我第一次来就要被扒光了？

lines.en: : Is that not how this normally goes?
lines.zh: : 平时不都是这么来的吗？

lines.en: : Sorry, just a little unfamiliar with the process.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，只是对这套流程不太熟。

lines.en: : I just really like your pants.
lines.zh: : 我就是特别喜欢你这条裤子。

lines.en: : I take it you two have been getting along well?
lines.zh: : 看来你们俩处得不错？

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm2
: Almost a little {i}too{/i} well.
lines.zh: : 好得有点{i}过头{/i}了。

lines.en: : It’s really convenient that we both happened to transfer in on the same day.
lines.zh: : 我们俩刚好是同一天转进来的，这真是太巧了。

lines.en: : Even if Noriko totally stole the spotlight and made my introduction seem super boring by comparison.
lines.zh: : 虽然 Noriko 完全抢走了风头，把我的自我介绍衬托得超级无聊。

lines.en: : The trick is to make everyone hate you on the first day so things can only go up from there.
lines.zh: : 诀窍是第一天就让所有人都恨你，之后就只会往好里走。

lines.en: : And here I was thinking that getting people to dislike you should be more of a slow burn.
lines.zh: : 我还以为让人讨厌你应该更像个慢热的过程。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm3
: So, what do you think? Pretty nice place, huh?
lines.zh: : 那么，你觉得怎么样？挺不错的房间吧，嗯？

lines.en: : We spent the whole day decorating it. And after seeing some of the other girls’ rooms, I think ours is among the best.
lines.zh: : 我们花了一整天装饰它。而且看过其他一些女孩的房间之后，我觉得我们的是最好的之一。

lines.en: : By among the best she just means the best.
lines.zh: : 她说“最好的之一”，其实就是“最好的”。

lines.en: : Yes. Yes, I do.
lines.zh: : 对。我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : But after seeing the garbage dump that is Uta and Io’s room, it’s not like our competition is really all that strong.
lines.zh: : 不过看过 Uta 和 Io 那个垃圾堆一样的房间之后，我们的竞争对手其实也没强到哪儿去。

lines.en: : It’s a competition now?
lines.zh: : 现在这是比赛了？

lines.en: : Everything is a competition, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 什么都是比赛，老师。

lines.en: : Love...dorms...pretty much every aspect of life becomes a battle when you put a bunch of like-minded girls in one place and tell them only one can survive.
lines.zh: : 爱……宿舍……只要把一群想法差不多的女孩放到一个地方，再告诉她们只有一个人能活下来，人生的几乎每个层面都会变成战斗。

lines.en: : Who told you that only one of you is going to survive?
lines.zh: : 谁告诉你们只有一个人能活下来的？

lines.en: : I just can’t see this ending any other way.
lines.zh: : 我只是想不出这还能有别的结局。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm4
I step between Kirin and Noriko and begin to observe what I imagine is Kirin’s side of the room.
lines.zh: 我走到 Kirin 和 Noriko 之间，开始打量我想应该是 Kirin 那半边的房间。

lines.en: I’m not exactly sure what I was expecting, but it’s definitely more well put together than I imagined it would be for someone who hasn’t had their own room, well, ever.
lines.zh: 我不太确定自己原本期待看到什么，但它确实比我想象中一个从没拥有过自己房间的人能弄出来的样子要整齐得多。

lines.en: I wonder if all of those years of wanting to get out are what gave her the power to make this place...livable?
lines.zh: 我在想，是不是那些年想要逃出去的念头，才给了她把这个地方变得……能住人的力量？

lines.en: Unlike the garbage dump that is Uta and Io's room.
lines.zh: 不像 Uta 和 Io 那个垃圾堆一样的房间。

lines.en: I feel a little bad for adding to the insult, but...come on.
lines.zh: 我有点不好意思再补一刀，但……拜托。

lines.en: How could the two of them ever let that happen?
lines.zh: 她们俩怎么能让事情变成那样？

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm5
: Does it live up to your expectations, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 有没有辜负你的期待，老师？

lines.en: : I’m just glad you aren’t also a trainwreck.
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴你也不是一场灾难。

lines.en: : I consider myself more of a calculated disaster.
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己更像一场精心算计的灾难。

lines.en: : The same appeal as a trainwreck where you don’t want to look away, but with significantly less shredded metal and all of that other morbid stuff.
lines.zh: : 和火车脱轨一样让人移不开眼，但碎金属和其他那些病态的东西少得多。

lines.en: : That is a strangely specific way to describe yourself.
lines.zh: : 用这么具体的方式形容自己，还挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : That’s not my description. It’s Noriko’s.
lines.zh: : 那不是我形容的。是 Noriko 形容的。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : I’m not one to judge how people get to know each other, but-
lines.zh: : 我倒不是要评判别人是怎么互相认识的，但是——

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm6
: Oh.
: You are very close.
lines.zh: : 你们关系很好啊。

lines.en: : Am I?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : You’re not actually blind, are you?
lines.zh: : 你其实不是瞎子，对吧？

lines.en: : Blinded by your beauty, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 被你的美貌蒙蔽了双眼，老师。

lines.en: : First, please don’t call me beautiful.
lines.zh: : 首先，请不要说我美。

lines.en: : Noted.
lines.zh: : 记住了。

lines.en: : Second, are you sure it’s okay to be calling your new roommate a-
lines.zh: : 其次，你确定这么叫你的新室友——

lines.en: : Calculated disaster? Yes.
lines.zh: : 精心算计的灾难？确定。

lines.en: : Yeah, I really don’t care.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我真的不在乎。

lines.en: : Noriko’s not “all there” herself, so the two of us can just put our minds together and create one socially acceptable human being.
lines.zh: : Noriko 自己也不太“正常”，所以我们俩把脑子凑一块儿，就能拼出一个社会上能接受的人。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm7
: Two for the price of one sounds pretty good, right?
lines.zh: : 买一送一听起来挺划算的，对吧？

lines.en: : Always.
lines.zh: : 一直都很划算。

lines.en: : I just don’t want to leave this room thinking you’re on good terms just to find out that one of you killed the other one in their sleep the next day.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想走出这个房间的时候以为你们关系很好，第二天就发现你们其中一个在睡梦中把另一个杀了。

lines.en: : Why does everyone always think I’m going to kill someone in their sleep?
lines.zh: : 为什么大家都觉得我会在别人睡觉的时候杀人？

lines.en: : Probably the pocket knife and crazy eyes combo.
lines.zh: : 大概是折刀加上疯狂眼神的组合吧。

lines.en: : Crazy eyes? Are my eyes crazy?
lines.zh: : 疯狂眼神？我的眼神很疯狂吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but they work for you. It’s cute.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但在你身上挺合适的。很可爱。

lines.en: : Awwwww, Kirin~
lines.zh: : 哎呀呀，Kirin~

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm8
: So, when did you want to fuck me?
lines.zh: : 那么，你想什么时候操我？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : I don’t know if it’s safe for me to answer that question with Noriko directly behind me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道在 Noriko 就站在我背后的情况下回答这个问题安不安全。

lines.en: : You literally just mentioned her pocket knife and crazy eyes.
lines.zh: : 你刚刚才提到她的折刀和疯狂眼神。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Noriko and I made a pact.
lines.zh: : 没事的。我和 Noriko 立过约。

lines.en: : A pact? What kind of pact?
lines.zh: : 立约？什么约？

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm6
: Kirin gets to have your dick and I get to have your heart.
lines.zh: : Kirin 得到你的鸡巴，我得到你的心。

lines.en: : And also your dick.
lines.zh: : 还有你的鸡巴。

lines.en: : We laid ground rules when we moved in together.
lines.zh: : 我们搬进来的时候定下了基本规则。

lines.en: : I can’t say I’m fond of the prospect of you fucking my friend in my room, but I’ve already come to terms with you fucking my sister, so one more won’t hurt as long as there are no feelings involved.
lines.zh: : 我不能说我喜欢你在我房间里操我朋友这个前景，但既然我已经接受了你操我姐姐这件事，那再多一个也没什么，只要不牵扯感情。

lines.en: : Also, there won’t be any issue at all since I’m sure you’ll only want me in due-time anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且完全不会有问题，因为我相信你迟早也只会想要我。

lines.en: : This dorm room is weird.
lines.zh: : 这个宿舍房间好奇怪。

lines.en: : Hey! Eyes over here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嘿！眼睛看这边，老师。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm9
: You stand on my side of the dorm, you talk to {i}me{/i}. Got it?
lines.zh: : 你站在宿舍我这半边，就得跟{i}我{/i}说话。明白吗？

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m just realizing this is the closest I’ve been to a threesome inside of the dorms and it's making it hard to focus.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是意识到这是我在宿舍里离三人行最近的一次，害我有点集中不了注意力。

lines.en: : Oooooh! Everyone wins with a threesome! We can all live happily ever after~
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦！三人行大家都能赢！我们全都可以从此幸福快乐地生活在一起~

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm10
: So these, uhh...”ground rules” you two worked out-
lines.zh: : 那么，你们俩商量出来的那些，呃……“基本规则”……

lines.en: : What about them?
lines.zh: : 它们怎么了？

lines.en: : Is there anything I need to know?
lines.zh: : 有什么我需要知道的吗？

lines.en: : Like, who gets me on Thursdays, for instance?
lines.zh: : 比如，周四归谁之类的？

lines.en: : What, do you think Noriko and I are a divorced couple fighting for custody of our child or something?
lines.zh: : 什么，你以为我和 Noriko 是一对战孩子抚养权的离婚夫妻之类的吗？

lines.en: : It’s nothing like that.
lines.zh: : 完全不是那么回事。

lines.en: : We just need to be courteous to each other and not screw around while the other is in the room.
lines.zh: : 我们只需要对彼此客气点，别在对方在房间里的时候乱搞。

lines.en: : That is going to make the threesome very difficult.
lines.zh: : 那会让三人行非常困难。

lines.en: : Maybe we can set up like, a divider in the middle of the room and you can just walk to the other side after three or four thrusts?
lines.zh: : 也许我们可以在房间中间立个隔断，你每抽插三四下就走到另一边去？

lines.en: : Not counting future threesomes, obviously. But it’s not like we’re just going to jump into that right away, you know?
lines.zh: : 显然不算未来的三人行。但我们也不太可能马上就跳到那一步，你知道的吧？

lines.en: : I’m getting mixed signals here and I’m not sure what I should expect moving forward.
lines.zh: : 我接收到的信号很混乱，不知道接下来该期待什么。

lines.en: : Kirin wants to lose her virginity like any other dignified lady- bent over a vibrating bed in a love hotel.
lines.zh: : Kirin 想像任何其他有尊严的淑女一样失去童贞——在情人旅馆的震动床上弯着腰。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm11
: Oh, that actually sounds pretty neat. Thanks, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 哦，那听起来还挺不错的。谢了，Noriko。

lines.en: : I gotchoo, girl.
lines.zh: : 包在我身上，姐妹。

lines.en: : This is the first time I’ve ever heard someone call losing their virginity “neat.”
lines.zh: : 我还是第一次听到有人把失去童贞说成“挺不错”。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm12
: Sooooo, yeah. That’s basically the only major ground rule.
lines.zh: : 所——以，是啊。基本上就只有这么一条主要的基本规则。

lines.en: : Oh, and I also promised to never start feeling anything more than sexual attraction toward you but, let’s be real...me actually “liking” someone?
lines.zh: : 哦，我还答应过，对你除了性欲以外永远不会产生更多的感觉，不过说真的……我“喜欢”上某个人？

lines.en: : That’s just not possible.
lines.zh: : 那是不可能的。

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm13
: Of course I’m sure about that. Why wouldn’t I be?
lines.zh: : 我当然确定。我为什么不确定？

lines.en: : It just seemed like you might have been actually starting to, you know, {i}feel{/i} something the other day when you told me about transferring in.
lines.zh: : 只是感觉前几天你跟我说你转学过来的时候，好像真的开始……你知道，有{i}感觉{/i}了。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm14
: That was just a weird day! All I feel is horny!
lines.zh: : 那天只是很奇怪！我唯一感觉到的就是发情！

lines.en: : Like, right now?
lines.zh: : 比如，现在？

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm15
: No! Not right now, Noriko! I meant in general!
lines.zh: : 不是！不是现在，Noriko！我是说总体上！

lines.en: : I am a generally horny person who has no interest in actual romance!
lines.zh: : 我总体上就是个发情的人，对真正的恋爱毫无兴趣！

lines.en: : Okaaaaay~ But you know what happens if you break the contract~
lines.zh: : 好——吧~ 但你知道你要是违约了会怎么样~

lines.en: : Wait, yeah, what happens if she breaks the contract?
lines.zh: : 等等，对，她违约了会怎样？

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm16
: I get to dissect her.
lines.zh: : 我可以解剖她。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm17
: So, yeah. That’s how things stand.
lines.zh: : 所以，是啊。情况就是这样。

lines.en: : We can fuck each other, but we’re not allowed to feel anything on an emotional level or Noriko gets to cut me up.
lines.zh: : 我们可以互相操，但不允许在情感层面有任何感觉，不然 Noriko 就可以把我切开。

lines.en: : I believe the technical term is “friends with benefits.”
lines.zh: : 我觉得专业术语叫“炮友”。

lines.en: : Meanwhile, I’m the “childhood friend slash imouto” type.
lines.zh: : 而我呢，是“青梅竹马兼妹妹”那一型。

lines.en: : So not only am I caring and adorable like a little sister, I have years worth of pent up sexual aggression and curiosity all aimed right at you!
lines.zh: : 所以我不仅像个小妹妹一样贴心可爱，还有积攒了好几年的性欲和好奇心，全都在冲着你来！

lines.en: : And obviously I can’t compete with that.
lines.zh: : 而显然我没法跟那个竞争。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm18
: It’s like...totally fine this way! I wouldn’t have agreed otherwise.
lines.zh: : 这样……完全没问题！不然我也不会答应。

lines.en: : Now, can we just move onto something else?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们能换个话题了吗？

lines.en: : I feel like you’re trying to get me to second guess my instincts. And my instincts are exactly why I’ve managed to get as far as I have.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你在试图让我怀疑自己的直觉。而我的直觉正是我能走到今天这一步的原因。

lines.en: : And how far is that exactly?
lines.zh: : 那具体走到哪一步了？

lines.en: scene black
Kirin hops off of the bed and makes her way over to her desk, swiping a can off of it and taking a sip of some fruity-smelling energy drink.
lines.zh: Kirin 从床上跳下来，走到她的书桌前，从桌上抄起一罐饮料，喝了一口某种闻起来有水果味的能量饮料。

lines.en: There are several of the same exact cans strewn across the room, and it makes me question how much of tonight’s conversation has been sincere and...
lines.zh: 房间里散落着好几罐一模一样的罐子，这让我不禁怀疑今晚的对话有多少是真心话，又有多少……

lines.en: How much has been fueled by sugar and caffeine.
lines.zh: 是靠糖和咖啡因撑起来的。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm19
: Listen, I don’t know if you’re just trying to make me second guess myself, but I’m totally okay with things playing out like this.
lines.zh: : 听着，我不知道你是不是在试图让我自我怀疑，但事情这样发展我是完全接受的。

lines.en: : It’s how it {i}should{/i} be and it’s exactly what I {i}want{/i}.
lines.zh: : 事情本来就{i}该{/i}是这样，这正是我{i}想要{/i}的。

lines.en: : If anything, I should be happy that I met Noriko so I don't wind up falling into that weird harem thing you’ve got going on.
lines.zh: : 要说有什么的话，我应该高兴自己遇见了 Noriko，这样我就不会掉进你那一套奇怪的后宫里。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm20
: And I should be happy I met Kirin because I am going to shatter your harem and make you love me and only me.
lines.zh: : 而我也该高兴遇见了 Kirin，因为我要打碎你的后宫，让你只爱我一个人。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm21
: Also, she has a cute butt.
lines.zh: : 另外，她屁股很可爱。

lines.en: : Uhh...thank you?
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢？

lines.en: : Squeeeeeeeze~
: Do you two need some time alone?
lines.zh: : 你们俩需要独处一会儿吗？

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm22
: I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : We do, but it doesn’t involve butts.
lines.zh: : 需要，但跟屁股没关系。

lines.en: : I am mostly relieved, but also mildly disappointed to hear this news.
lines.zh: : 听到这个消息，我大体上松了口气，但也有点失望。

lines.en: : Same.
lines.zh: : 一样。

lines.en: : I just want to talk to her a little more about our contract thingy and make sure we’re both okay with the terms and conditions.
lines.zh: : 我只是想再跟她聊聊我们那个合约的事，确认一下我们俩都能接受那些条款和条件。

lines.en: : Ah. Well I should probably be heading back now anyway.
lines.zh: : 啊。那我大概也该回去了。

lines.en: : It’s getting late and becoming more apparent by the minute that there will be no threesome tonight.
lines.zh: : 天晚了，而且越来越明显的是，今晚不会有三人行了。

lines.en: : Does that make you sad?
lines.zh: : 那让你难过吗？

lines.en: : Sadder than you could ever imagine.
lines.zh: : 比你想象的还难过。

lines.en: : I see, I see.
lines.zh: : 我懂，我懂。

lines.en: scene firstkirinnorikodorm23
: Thanks for dropping by, though.
lines.zh: : 不过还是谢谢你过来。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll be here pretty often in the future, so...until next time, I guess?
lines.zh: : 我相信你以后会经常来的，所以……那就下次再见吧，我想？

lines.en: : Yup. Until next time it is.
lines.zh: : 嗯。那就下次。

lines.en: scene black
I say goodbye to the two of them and exit the dorm room, still slightly confused about the Kirin-Noriko character dynamic.
lines.zh: 我和她们俩道别，走出宿舍房间，对 Kirin 和 Noriko 之间的角色动态仍然有点困惑。

lines.en: It {i}seems{/i} that they get along, but I can’t help but feel like Kirin may have prematurely agreed to something she wasn’t exactly 100%% behind.
lines.zh: 她们{i}看起来{/i}相处得不错，但我还是忍不住觉得 Kirin 可能过早地答应了一件她自己并没有 100%% 认同的事。

lines.en: Granted, she also seems like the type to easily trick herself into thinking she doesn’t want something she actually does-
lines.zh: 当然，她也确实是那种会轻易骗自己、以为自己不想要其实想要的东西的人——

lines.en: So I guess she’ll be fine no matter what happens.
lines.zh: 所以我觉得不管发生什么，她都会没事的。

lines.en: I wish I was that good at manipulating my own thoughts.
lines.zh: 真希望我也有那么擅长操纵自己的想法。

lines.en: But I guess it’s just as beneficial to be gifted enough to manipulate others.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，有本事操纵别人也同样有好处。

lines.en: I’m looking forward to the time I’m going to spend in that room.
lines.zh: 我很期待在那个房间里要度过的时光。
